recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-31827 unless BR&R opens a later issue to revise these definitions.
issue_request: FHIR-31827 was a Published/Persuasive BR&R change request asking that the tautological SubstanceSpecification supplier definition be clarified and that manufacturer and supplier be explicitly differentiated, ideally with examples.
initial_application: The request was applied in the R5 SubstanceDefinition source. Commit 2ac0ae1b79cf51fd3a9cf869dea843ac91929bf8 first replaced the supplier tautology with supply-chain wording and carried related manufacturer wording from FHIR-31826; b779dcf8e3da5a0c0514c75b5435be2b09c8a691 refined wording; 9be2c2e67c4213e88ec07cbc8f55595e065bd428 applied the final FHIR-31827 manufacturer and supplier definitions that remain in the current source.
additional_context: The current build-scope artifact is SubstanceDefinition rather than the R4-era SubstanceSpecification name: source/fhir.ini actively lists substancedefinition=SubstanceDefinition and assigns it to BR&R. FHIR-31826 is a same-area supporting decision for the manufacturer cardinality explanation, and FHIR-25054 is historical background for adding the manufacturer and supplier elements. BR&R minutes record FHIR-31827 as change applied and persuasive with a 10-0-0 vote; Zulip and additional Confluence searches found no conflicting guidance.
reconciliation: No source change was made because source/substancedefinition/structuredefinition-SubstanceDefinition.xml already defines manufacturer as the entity that creates, makes, produces, or fabricates the substance and supplier as the source/distributor that may differ from the manufacturer.

related_jiras.note: Explains the adjacent manufacturer definition sentence saying the manufacturer list is a set of potential manufacturers but not necessarily comprehensive.
Earlier Published issue that added SubstanceDefinition.manufacturer and noted adding supplier, establishing the elements later clarified by FHIR-31827.
